title: Schedule versions, calendars and manual edits
question: Are uploaded schedules versioned, with a baseline and rollback? Which work calendar (weekends, holidays) applies? Are dependencies honoured? When someone edits a planned date by hand, does a later import overwrite it?
context: Manual timeline edits and imports write the same planned dates (SCHD-REQ-004). The schedule's working days skip weekends only, with no holidays (SCHD-REQ-009). Version history is a PRD candidate with no code (SCHD-REQ-003).
